name: Steve Wozniak
tagline: Designing the future, one chip at a time.
subtitle: Hardware engineering & Embedded systems
bio: Steve Wozniak is the Hardware Legend of the Statistics Programming Club. He pioneered the design of Apple I and Apple II, showcasing that hobbyist electrical engineering can revolutionize global computing. Known for his obsession with efficiency and minimalism, Woz continues to inspire engineers to build things that are not just functional, but elegant in their simplicity.

timeline.role: Co-founder & Chief Hardware Engineer, Apple Computer
CL 15 Educator, Los Gatos School District
Hardware Legend / Mentor, Statistics Programming Club

projects.title: Apple II Computer Design
projects.description: Designed the entire architecture of the Apple II, one of the first highly successful mass-produced microcomputers, featuring color graphics and expansion slots.

projects.title: Disk II Controller
projects.description: Invented a highly optimized floppy disk controller using minimal logic gates, making external storage affordable for home users.

projects.title: The Woz-Box (Custom Synth)
projects.description: Designed and built a custom analog synthesizer using discrete components to explore the intersection of music and electronics.

publications.title: The Art of Minimalist Hardware Design
